pinnedFiles.reason: Tick() is the one-pass loop (ADR-010). It currently calls ReadIntake(s.deps.Repository, s.config.IntakeBranch, ...) with no fetch step. Config and Dependencies need the new --remote/--no-fetch knobs and the fetch call belongs at the top of Tick, before ReadIntake.

Defines the consumer-side Repository interface (ResolveCommit, ListFiles, ShowFile, AddWorktree, RemoveWorktree) that worktree.Git satisfies, and ReadIntake(repo, branch, plans). A Fetch method belongs on this interface (architecture-guardrails #1/consumer-defines-interface), and ReadIntake's ref needs to become remote-tracking (<remote>/<branch>) rather than bare branch when fetching.

Where ResolveCommit (already falls back to origin/<ref>), AddWorktree, and Push live. Push already shows the required pattern for a network git call: context timeout, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, wrapped error with stderr. Fetch(remote, branch) must follow the same pattern and sits naturally next to Push.

claimFor() defaults an order's base to s.config.IntakeBranch when the order sets no base-branch, and prepare() passes that base straight to AddWorktree. AC3 (worktree starts from <remote>/<branch>) means this default must become the same remote-tracking ref Tick resolved, not the bare branch name.

Owns the --branch flag (default "main") and builds factory.Config in newFactorySupervisor. New --remote (default origin) and --no-fetch flags are added here and threaded into Config; this is also where the command's --help text (Long string) documents the new fetch behavior.

newTestFactory/newSupervisor builds every factory test's repo and Config with no remote configured at all — this is the concrete case AC6 (no remote -> read local branch unchanged, existing tests keep passing) must hold against. Likely needs a helper added for a bare-repo remote fixture for the new fetch tests.

Already has the exact bare-repo-as-remote pattern the spec's Test Approach asks for: an upstream bare repo, a clone, ResolveCommit falling back to origin/main (line ~94), and Push reaching origin (line ~157) plus a no-origin failure case (line ~255). The new Fetch tests extend this same pattern.

Existing Tick-level tests for the supervisor's one-pass behavior; new cases (fetch runs once per pass, fetch failure doesn't park/fail an order, no-fetch/no-remote preserves today's behavior) belong alongside these and must not break what's already asserted here.

AC8 requires this file to say orders are read from the remote after a fetch, that a promotion must be pushed, and how --no-fetch restores the old behavior. The "Enforced at pickup, by loom factory (ADR-010)" section is the specific paragraph to amend.

The ADR every touched file's comments cite ("ADR-010, 2B" for reading intake off a committed branch, "ADR-010, 1C" for claim snapshots, "ADR-010, 3A" for stop/resume). The analyst needs this to state the Owning Context consistently with the two prior deliveries in this bounded context and to check whether fetch-before-read needs an ADR amendment or is just an implementation detail under 2B.
